forecasts.reason: Time-neutral; the anneal end shift is likely within noise, E009 says the LR floor is irrelevant.
Costs ~0.08 s and probably gains 0.05-0.15 pp, roughly the dial rate, so the result is a wash.
E014 gave a small positive at 3 seeds, so the effect is likely within ±0.15 pp.
Identical math, and some launch overhead is removable, so a ~1% saving is plausible but small.
There is no measured prior on momentum. Muon with a short run may prefer the low-momentum default, so I lean slightly negative.
A diagnostic with no recipe change. The train accuracy is likely ~80-90%, which points to under-fitting.

What is the true rebuild-plus-seed noise of a 60-draw mean? Most keep/discard decisions sit below it.
Does the early 20 px trim stay free below 225 steps? This is the last cheap time lever.
